course.title: Atomic – Cambridge Lower Secondary Mathematics — Stage 7

unit.title: Graphs
unit.blurb: Functions written as equations, tables of values, plotting straight-line graphs, lines parallel to the axes and reading real-life graphs.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Understand a function as a rule linking an input and an output, written in words or as an equation.

O2.t: Complete a table of values and plot the graph of a linear function.

O3.t: Recognise and draw lines parallel to the axes, such as x = 3 and y = −2.

O4.t: Read and interpret graphs of real-life situations, including conversion graphs.

p: A **function** turns every input into one output. 'Multiply by 2 then add 1' can be written as an equation: **y = 2x + 1**, where x is the input and y is the output.

p: Read the labels and scales on both axes. To read a value, go up from the x-axis to the line, then across to the y-axis.
A **conversion graph** changes one unit into another, e.g. dollars to euros or km to miles.
Work out what one small square is worth before you read a value.
